newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Britain, China discuss transfer of Hong Kong files.
newsitem.headline: Britain, China discuss transfer of Hong Kong files.

text.p: Britain and China met on Thursday to discuss the sensitive issue of the transfer of Hong Kong government archives when the territory reverts to Beijing's control next year.
"The discussion went quite well. We covered a lot of ground," said Alan Paul, Britain's representative at the meeting of the Sino-British Joint Liaison Group (JLG).
The JLG is responsible for hammering out details of the sovereignty change, which takes place at midnight on June 30 next year, ending more than 150 years of British colonial rule.

Over the past year China and Britain have been at loggerheads over the transfer of government files as London has refused Beijing's request to hand over sensitive information on the territory's civil servants. The talks continue on Friday.
